easy.def: A wild cat with tufts of fur on its ears and a short tail.
examples: A lynx lives in the forest.

more.def: A medium-sized wild cat with pointed ears with tufts of fur and a short tail.
examples: A lynx stalked through the snowy forest.
The lynx has big paws that work like snowshoes.
We saw a lynx in a photo at the park.

more.def: The words that are sung in a song.
examples: I know all the lyrics to the song.
She wrote the lyrics and he wrote the tune.
